newsitem.title: USA: Mongolia leader to meet U.S. officials Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia leader to meet U.S. officials Wednesday.

text.p: Mongolian Prime Minister M. Enkhsaikhan will hold talks with Deputy Secretary of State Strobe Talbott on Wednesday, the State Department said on Tuesday.

Enkhsaikhan, who was at the U.N. General Assembly in New York, is on his first visit to the United States since coming to power in July. He took office after the Democratic Union Coalition ousted the long-ruling ex-Communist Party in Mongolia's June 30 parliamentary election.

Talbott and Enkhsaikhan, who is also foreign minister, are expected to discuss ongoing cooperation between their two countries on a broad range of economic and political issues, U.S. spokesman Nicholas Burns said.
Also, they will discuss continuing U.S. support for Mongolia's fledgling democracy and free market economic reform, he said.
Enkhsaikhan is also expected to meet National Security Adviser Anthony Lake.
